note: Suggested prices are starting points for Creator Hub; Roblox reads prices at runtime, regional pricing and price optimization change them. Change products by editing this plan's inputs and re-running plan --force, or edit the generated files and re-run check.

products.name: VIP
products.description: VIP tag, VIP-only area and +25% Gold forever.
products.icon_brief: crown or gold star badge on the game's mascot, gold rim
products.why: Status plus a modest boost; the most common pass in top games and an easy first purchase.

products.name: Starter Pack
products.description: A one-time bundle for new players: Gold, a boost and an exclusive item.
products.icon_brief: gift box with the exclusive item peeking out, 'STARTER' banner
products.why: First purchase converts non-payers; once a player pays once they pay again. Show early, once a session, with a personal 24 h timer.

products.name: Pouch of Gold
products.why: Ladder step 2; bonus grows with each step (amount_base already includes it).

products.name: Chest of Gold
products.why: The middle pack is the most bought when it carries the 'most popular' ribbon (decoy against the extremes).

products.name: Vault of Gold
products.description: A vault of Gold: the best value.
products.icon_brief: a vault door bursting with coins
products.why: Best value per Robux; where most currency revenue comes from in top games (whales).

products.name: Gift VIP
products.description: Buy VIP for a friend in this server.
products.icon_brief: VIP crown in a gift box
products.why: Passes cannot be bought for others, so top games sell a developer product that grants the same entitlement to a chosen player.

products.name: 2x XP
products.description: Level up twice as fast, forever.
products.icon_brief: '2x' with an XP star or level-up arrow
products.why: Pairs with level-based progression (RPG, shooter ranks, battlegrounds) without selling raw power.

products.name: 2x Gold
products.description: Earn double Gold from everything, forever.
products.icon_brief: big '2x' over a pile of the game's currency
products.why: The single best-selling pass shape in simulators, tycoons and idle games; value is obvious.

products.name: +Storage
products.description: More inventory slots for items, pets or units.
products.why: Convenience that grows with play time; collectors hit the cap and buy.

products.name: Revive
products.description: Come back where you fell, with full health.
products.why: Survival, horror and PvE wave games sell revives at the death screen; in PvP it buys a fight, so it is off there.

products.name: 2x Gold (30 min)
products.description: Double Gold for 30 minutes of play.
products.why: Repeatable timed boosts are the main repeat-purchase product of simulators; stack with the pass.

products.name: Luck Potion (15 min)
products.icon_brief: green potion bottle with a clover
products.why: RNG and pet games sell luck potions as the top repeat product.

products.name: Mountain of Gold
products.icon_brief: a mountain of coins with a crown
products.why: Price anchor at the top of the ladder (top games list a 1,999-7,999 'whale anchor'); a few players buy it and it makes the rest look cheap.

products.name: Season Pass
products.description: Unlock the premium reward track for this season.
products.icon_brief: ribbon banner with the season's emblem
products.why: Battle-pass style tracks (GameKit/SeasonTrack) monetize retention; resell each season as a new pass.
